BUFFTHESPIRE-EPHEMERAL_POWER.title: Ephemeral
BUFFTHESPIRE-EPHEMERAL_POWER.description: After taking damage 5 times during your turn, gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
BUFFTHESPIRE-EPHEMERAL_POWER.smartDescri: After taking damage {Amount} times during your turn, gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
BUFFTHESPIRE-SEARING_BLOW_POWER.title: Searing Blow
BUFFTHESPIRE-SEARING_BLOW_POWER.descript: On dealing unblocked attack damage, [gold]Transforms[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] cards from the top of your draw pile into [gold]Burns[/gold]. Reduced by 1 this turn whenever this enemy takes damage.
BUFFTHESPIRE-SEARING_BLOW_POWER.smartDes: On dealing unblocked attack damage, [gold]Transforms[/gold] [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards from the top of your draw pile into [gold]Burns[/gold]. Reduced by 1 this turn whenever this enemy takes damage.
BUFFTHESPIRE-SUCKER_PUNCH_POWER.title: Sucker Punch
BUFFTHESPIRE-SUCKER_PUNCH_POWER.descript: On dealing unblocked attack damage, Adds [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] to your draw pile. Reduced by 1 this turn whenever this enemy takes damage.
BUFFTHESPIRE-SUCKER_PUNCH_POWER.smartDes: On dealing unblocked attack damage, Adds [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] to your draw pile. Reduced by 1 this turn whenever this enemy takes damage.
BUFFTHESPIRE-QUICKSAND_POWER.title: Quicksand
BUFFTHESPIRE-QUICKSAND_POWER.description: For every turn's distance you are from [gold]The Insatiable[/gold], take 2 damage at the end of your turn.
BUFFTHESPIRE-QUICKSAND_POWER.smartDescri: For every turn's distance you are from [gold]The Insatiable[/gold], take 2 damage at the end of your turn.
